description:
Search X's last 7 days for people asking something you could answer,
score each thread 0..100, and store the result under your npub for
``list_conversations`` to page through.

Pass exactly one of ``query_id`` (a saved query from
``save_conversation_query``) or ``query`` (an ad-hoc X search clause — your
domain nouns are the selector; X has no ``?`` operator). ``safe_defaults``
appends ``-is:retweet -has:links -has:cashtags lang:en`` (a photo is not a
link); your own posts are always excluded. ``max_posts`` caps the read
(10..300) — every post X returns is billed to the operator, which is what
this tool's fare covers. A saved query re-run reads only posts newer than
its last run. ``weights`` overrides the scoring for this call (keys:
need, replies, band, spam, reply, replies_min, followers_min,
followers_max, decay_hours).

Returns ``{posts_read, pages, new, refreshed, skipped_own, skipped_dupe,
truncated_reason, top:[…]}``. Nothing is posted, liked or replied to —
the reply is yours to write and send by hand.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

max_posts.description: Most posts to read from X, 10..300.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

query.description:
An ad-hoc X search clause, up to 438 characters, with no ``?``
operator. Give this or ``query_id``.

query_id.description: UUID of a saved query to run. Give this or ``query``.

safe_defaults.description:
``true`` appends ``-is:retweet -has:links -has:cashtags
lang:en`` to an ad-hoc ``query``; a saved query uses its own setting.

weights.description:
Scoring overrides for this call, an object whose keys are any
of ``need``, ``replies``, ``band``, ``spam``, ``reply``,
``replies_min``, ``followers_min``, ``followers_max``,
``decay_hours`` with integer values, laid over the saved query's
weights or the defaults; null adds no overrides.

name: excalibur_find_conversations
title: Find conversations
